concerns.text: T014a introduces a 'predefined species-range dataset' for fallback mapping. No such entity, data source, or requirement exists in spec.md (FR-001) or plan.md. This is scope creep; the spec only mandates alignment by species ID and coordinates.

FR-006 requires FDR control 'across different song metrics' (joint correction). T032a/T032 describe the procedure but lack a task to explicitly aggregate p-values from both `song_metric_1` and `song_metric_2` models into a single pool before correction, risking a violation of the statistical requirement.

SC-002 requires measuring 'quantifiable improvement' in R² against a null model. T030 implements the null model fit but lacks a dedicated task to calculate and report the delta (R²_model - R²_null) as a concrete metric, leaving the success criterion unimplemented.

Constitution Principle III and V require checksums to be recorded in the project's state file (`state/projects/...yaml` `artifact_hashes` map). Tasks T004, T011, T012 only record to `data/checksums.txt`, failing to satisfy the 'Single Source of Truth' and 'Versioning Discipline' requirements.

FR-001 and US-1 Acceptance Scenario 3 require 'automatic' reprojection when mismatched systems are detected. T013 implements the logic but lacks a task to define the trigger condition or input detection mechanism required to satisfy the 'Given mismatched coordinate systems' scenario.

T005 defines a configurable `join_radius_km` but the spec and plan do not define a default value or determination method. Without a default, the spatial join cannot run without manual intervention, violating the reproducibility requirement implied by the Constitution.
